card.title: Command with an Escape Hatch
card.instruction: Carry yourself as though every decision settles the matter, while preserving one ambiguity that lets you later reverse what the decision meant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your garden party is approved for a small gathering. Go ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Small means everyone fits round our table. The approval stands.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our table means the one we own. Tell the others their invitations are for another small gathering.

mechanism: A declares firm approval while narrowing the reserved meaning of small to reverse its practical scope.
confusable: Unlike openly changing a decision, A must insist it stands while exploiting an ambiguous condition.
comparison: S217-a narrows which table counts; S217-b narrows whether short refers to distance or duration.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
